editorial.blurb: Raul & Theresa's is a humble, family-owned Tex-Mex spot in Avondale that wins over regulars with hearty portions and potent margaritas, though service can be inconsistent.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the margaritas—reviewers rave about them—but stick to one if you're driving; ask for mild salsa on the side since their house salsa is extremely hot.

topDishes.note: A reviewer's experience with sparse meat was disappointing, but others praised the quality and quantity of food overall
